errorCodes.meaning: `recordId` names no notification the community holds — never held, or discarded after it lapsed.

The community may not relay the notification: its `relayable` is false, its kind may not be relayed, or the chain it arrived by already carries four relays, so that the community's own would make more than four (VTI-NTF-041).
The notification is withdrawn, or its `validUntil` has passed: there is nothing to tell members of.

The notification's kind says a relay discloses something about the community, and the request does not carry `disclosureAcknowledged` true (VTI-NTF-046). `details` carries the statement to show the administrator.
`recipients.groupId` names no community group, or one the caller may not see.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

GroupId.description: Opaque identifier of a community group: `grp_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and community-scoped; not the group's DID.
GroupId.title: GroupId

RecipientScope.description: Which of the community's members a relay decision reaches: `allMembers` — every active member; `group` — the active members of one community group; `role` — the active members holding one community role.
RecipientScope.title: RecipientScope

Recipients.description: The members a relay decision reaches, resolved by the community from its own records when the decision is made (VTI-NTF-072). `groupId` is present exactly when `scope` is `group`, and `role` exactly when `scope` is `role`. Whatever the scope, the community never relays to itself, to the notification's originator, or to any relayer the received chain names (VTI-NTF-047), and relays to each party at most once per revision.

groupId.description: The community group whose active members the relay reaches.

role.description: The community role whose active holders the relay reaches, in the wire form the community's member records use — for example `moderator`, or `custom:editor`.

Recipients.title: Recipients

RecordId.description: The community's own identifier for one received notification, stable across the revisions that replace it. Opaque and compared for equality only; unguessable, because a read by a caller without the capability is refused and an enumerable identifier would turn the refusal into an oracle.
RecordId.title: RecordId

recipientCount.description: How many parties this decision added to those the notification is relayed to, each of which the community has queued one relay for. Zero when the selection reaches no member an earlier decision had not.

revision.description: The revision of the notification the decision relays.

schema.description: An administrator with `vtc.notifications.relay` decides that the community relays one notification it holds to some of its members — all of them, the members of one group, or the holders of one community role — having been shown what the relay discloses about the community (VTI-NTF-046, VTI-NTF-071 – VTI-NTF-073). The community relays the document it received exactly as received, one notifications/relay/0.1 per member, never to itself, the originator or any earlier relayer, and relays every later revision to the same members without a further decision (VTI-NTF-044). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

disclosureAcknowledged.description: The administrator's statement that they were shown the notification's `relayDisclosure` and decide the relay knowing it (VTI-NTF-046). REQUIRED to be true for a notification whose kind's definition says a relay discloses something; ignored for one whose definition says nothing is disclosed.

schema.title: VTC Notifications — Relay — payload
